home_s1_study_dad.grammar_tag: What's this? · It's a... · 一般疑问句 Is this...?
home_s1_study_dad.grammar_tip: 指认身边的单个物品用 What's this? 回答用 It's a + 物品名；确认归属用 Is this your...? 回答 Yes, it is!
home_s1_study_dad.book_ref: 湘少版三年级上册 · Unit 4–6 书房文具指认
home_s1_study_dad.speaker: 爸爸 Dad · 窗边书房
home_s1_study_dad.title_zh: 和爸爸在书房认识桌椅与文具

turns.npc_en: Hi sweetie! Come to your study desk and sit on the chair. Look on the desk — what's this?
turns.npc_zh: 宝贝过来坐到书桌前的椅子上吧！看看书桌上——这是什么呀？

options.scaffold_zh: 爸爸在指着书桌上的物品问 What's this?（这是什么），试试用 It's a... 来回答吧！
现在正在书房认文具呢，试试回答桌上的蓝钢笔（It's a blue pen）吧！

turns.npc_en: Right, it's a pen! And look beside the English book — is this your green ruler?
turns.npc_zh: 对啦，是一支钢笔！再看看英语书旁边——这把绿尺子是你的吗？

options.en: Yes, it is! Thank you, Dad.
options.zh: 是的，它是我的！谢谢爸爸。

options.scaffold_zh: 爸爸用 Is this your...?（这是你的……吗？）提问时，先用 Yes, it is! 或 No, it isn't. 回应最自然哦！
还没收拾好尺子呢，试试回答 Yes, it is! 吧！

turns.npc_en: Great! Please put your pen and ruler in your pencil-box so your desk stays tidy.
turns.npc_zh: 太棒了！请把钢笔和尺子收进文具盒里，让书桌保持整洁吧。

options.en: OK, Dad! Now my desk is neat!
options.zh: 好的爸爸！现在我的书桌整整齐齐啦！

options.scaffold_zh: 回应爸爸的温馨提醒（Please put...），用 OK, Dad! 最合适哦！
试试答应爸爸把文具收整齐（OK, Dad!）吧！

home_s1_living_mom.grammar_tag: 日常礼貌问候 · I like... · Have some..., please!
home_s1_living_mom.grammar_tip: 家里招待或分享食物用 Have some..., please! 表达喜欢某类水果用复数 I like apples / bananas。
home_s1_living_mom.book_ref: 湘少版三年级上册 & 下册 · 家庭问候与水果分享
home_s1_living_mom.speaker: 妈妈 Mom · 温馨客厅
home_s1_living_mom.title_zh: 和妈妈在客厅问好、分享水果

turns.npc_en: Good morning, sweetie! Come and sit on the sofa. Look at the fruit plate on the table!
turns.npc_zh: 早上好呀宝贝！过来坐到沙发上，看看茶几上的果盘吧！

options.en: Good morning, Mom! Wow, red apples and yellow bananas!
options.zh: 早上好妈妈！哇，有红苹果和黄香蕉！

options.scaffold_zh: 妈妈在向你道早安（Good morning），先回应 Good morning, Mom! 吧！
这是在自家客厅果盘旁哦，试试夸夸红苹果和黄香蕉吧！

turns.npc_en: Have an apple, please! Do you like sweet apples?
turns.npc_zh: 请吃颗苹果吧！你喜欢甜甜的苹果吗？

options.en: Yes, I do! I like sweet apples. Thank you, Mom!
options.zh: 喜欢！我喜欢甜苹果，谢谢妈妈！

options.scaffold_zh: 注意语法细节：妈妈问 Do you like...? 回答要用 Yes, I do!（而不是 I am）哦！
先礼貌回答妈妈 Do you like apples? 的提问吧！

turns.npc_en: You're welcome, dear! Put your cap in the basket before you go out to play.
turns.npc_zh: 不客气宝贝！出门玩耍前记得把小帽子放进门厅藤篮里。

options.en: All right, Mom! See you later!

options.scaffold_zh: 答应妈妈的叮嘱并道别，选 All right, Mom! See you later! 最自然！
试试用 All right, Mom! 回应妈妈吧！

home_s2_continuous_mom.grammar_tag: 方位介词 in/on/under · 现在进行时 (be + doing)
home_s2_continuous_mom.grammar_tip: 询问物品位置用 Where is...? (It's on/in/under...)；描述家人此时此刻正在做的事用【现在进行时：am/is/are + 动词ing】！
home_s2_continuous_mom.book_ref: 湘少版四年级上册 & 下册 · Where's my...? & What are you doing?
home_s2_continuous_mom.speaker: 妈妈 Mom · 方位与正在进行时
home_s2_continuous_mom.title_zh: 在家找书包、说一说爸爸和小猫正在做什么

turns.npc_en: Sweetie, you look busy! What are you looking for in the living room?
turns.npc_zh: 宝贝，你在客厅里忙着找什么呢？（注意看进行时 are looking for）

options.en: Mom, where is my schoolbag? I can't find it!
options.zh: 妈妈，我的书包在哪里？我找不到它啦！

options.scaffold_zh: 你想问妈妈书包“在哪里”，试试用疑问词 Where is my schoolbag? 提问吧！
妈妈问你现在正在找什么，用 Where is my schoolbag? 最贴切！

turns.npc_en: Haha, look beside the wooden chair! Is it under the table or on the chair?
turns.npc_zh: 哈哈，往木椅子那边看！它在桌子下面，还是在椅子上面呀？

options.en: Aha! It's on the chair, and my cap is under the table!
options.zh: 啊哈！它在椅子上面，我的帽子在桌子下面！

options.scaffold_zh: 看清楚方位介词哦：on the chair（在椅子上），under the table（在桌子下）！
用 It's on the chair 说出书包的位置吧！

turns.npc_en: Shh, listen! Where is Dad right now, and what is he doing?
turns.npc_zh: 嘘，听！爸爸现在在哪里？他【正在做什么】（What is he doing）？

options.en: He is in the study. He is reading a book!
options.zh: 他在书房里，他正在看书呢！（is reading）
他看书。（缺少进行时 is reading）
options.scaffold_zh: 语法关键点：问 What is he doing?（正在做什么），回答要用【He is + V-ing】→ He is reading a book!
妈妈问的是他此刻正在做的动作（doing），选 He is reading a book! 吧！

home_s3_routine_future.grammar_tag: 一般现在时 (often/usually) · 一般将来时 (will / be going to)
home_s3_routine_future.grammar_tip: 平时常做的家务与习惯用【一般现在时：I often water...】；接下来打算做的事用【一般将来时：I will... / I'm going to...】！
home_s3_routine_future.book_ref: 湘少版五年级上册 U7 家务习惯 & 五年级下册 U6 制作贺卡计划
home_s3_routine_future.speaker: 爸爸 Dad · 习惯与将来计划
home_s3_routine_future.title_zh: 和爸爸聊日常家务习惯与给妈妈的惊喜计划

turns.npc_en: Our home looks so clean today! What chores do you usually do at home?
turns.npc_zh: 今天咱们家真干净！你平时在家里通常做哪些家务呀？（一般现在时）

options.en: I often make my bed and water the plants!
options.zh: 我经常整理床铺，还给绿植浇水！（often + 动词原形）

options.en: I am watering the plant yesterday.
options.zh: 时态混啦（am watering 与 yesterday 冲突）
options.scaffold_zh: 问平时经常做的习惯（usually / often），要用【一般现在时】：I often make my bed and water the plants!
爸爸在问你平时做什么家务（What chores do you do），试试用 I often... 回答！

turns.npc_en: Mom works hard cooking meals in the kitchen. Tomorrow is Sunday — what are we going to do for her?
turns.npc_zh: 妈妈在厨房做饭很辛苦。明天就是周日了——我们【打算】为她做点什么呢？（be going to 将来时）

options.en: We're going to cook breakfast and wash the vegetables!
options.zh: 我们打算一起做早餐、把蔬菜洗干净！（are going to + 动词原形）
我们上周做了早餐。（这是过去时哦）
options.scaffold_zh: 注意时间词 Tomorrow（明天）和问句 what are we going to do，要用【一般将来时 We're going to...】哦！

options.en: Mom is in the living room.
options.scaffold_zh: 试试用 We're going to cook breakfast... 说出明天的计划吧！

turns.npc_en: Wonderful idea! And what gift will you make on your study desk for Mom?
turns.npc_zh: 好主意！那你还【将要】在书房书桌上给妈妈做一份什么礼物呢？（will + 动词原形）

options.en: I'll make a beautiful card and draw flowers on it!
options.zh: 我将要做一张漂亮的贺卡，在上面画满鲜花！（I'll = I will）
缺少助动词（应为 I'll make）
options.scaffold_zh: 用 will 表达将来的心愿时，后面直接跟动词原形：I'll make a beautiful card!
在书桌上做礼物送给妈妈，选 I'll make a beautiful card! 最贴心！

home_s4_past_dinner.grammar_tag: 一般过去时 (was / had / played / learned) · 建议 should
home_s4_past_dinner.grammar_tip: 放学回家跟爸妈聊“今天在学校发生了什么”，动词要变成【过去式：have→had, play→played, see→saw】；提健康环保建议用 should / shouldn't！
home_s4_past_dinner.book_ref: 湘少版六年级上册 & 下册 · 过去经历叙事与环保生活习惯
home_s4_past_dinner.speaker: 妈妈 Mom · 晚餐桌聊今日见闻
home_s4_past_dinner.title_zh: 在餐桌上跟爸妈用过去时分享今天学校发生的事

turns.npc_en: Dinner is ready! Come to the dining table. How was your day at school today?
turns.npc_zh: 晚饭做好啦！快到餐桌边坐下。今天在学校过得怎么样呀？（注意过去式 was）

options.en: It was great! We had a really fun science class this morning.
options.zh: 棒极了！今天上午我们上了一节超有趣的科学课。（was / had 过去式）

options.scaffold_zh: 妈妈用 How was your day? 问已经度过的今天，要用过去式 It was great! We had... 来回答哦！
和妈妈聊聊今天学校过得怎么样（It was great!）吧！

turns.npc_en: Oh, how exciting! What did you do with your classmates after class?
turns.npc_zh: 哇，真有意思！那下课后你和同学们【做了】什么呢？（What did you do 过去时）

options.en: I played football with Peter and read stories with Lingling!
options.zh: 我和彼得踢了足球，还和玲玲一起读了故事！（played / read 过去式）

options.en: I will play football next Monday.
options.zh: 我下周一将去踢球。（这是将来时哦）
options.scaffold_zh: 注意助动词 did 问的是已经做过的事，动词要用过去式：played football！
试试用过去式 I played football with Peter... 分享课间活动吧！

turns.npc_en: You had a wonderful day! Now let's wash our hands in the bathroom before eating. What should we remember?
turns.npc_zh: 真是充实的一天！饭前先去浴室洗洗手吧，我们【应该】记住什么节水好习惯？（should / shouldn't）

options.en: We should turn off the tap. We shouldn't waste water!
options.zh: 我们应该关紧水龙头，不应该浪费水！（should / shouldn't + 动词原形）

options.scaffold_zh: 情态动词 should / shouldn't 后面直接接动词原形：We shouldn't waste water!
选节水环保句 We should turn off the tap. We shouldn't waste water! 吧！

home_s1_bedroom_clothes_mom.grammar_tag: 颜色与衣物指认 · Look at my... · Put on...
home_s1_bedroom_clothes_mom.grammar_tip: 介绍自己的衣物用 Look at my blue shirt / pink dress! 妈妈提醒穿衣出门用祈使句 Put on your coat / shoes!
home_s1_bedroom_clothes_mom.book_ref: 湘少版三年级下册 · Unit 5–8 颜色、衣物与日常穿戴
home_s1_bedroom_clothes_mom.speaker: 妈妈 Mom · 温暖卧室
home_s1_bedroom_clothes_mom.title_zh: 在卧室打开衣柜和妈妈挑选上学穿搭

turns.npc_en: Time to get dressed for school! Open your wardrobe — what colour is your clean shirt?
turns.npc_zh: 该穿衣服准备上学啦！打开你的衣柜看看——干净衬衫是什么颜色的？

options.en: Look, Mom! My shirt is sky blue!
options.zh: 看呀妈妈！我的衬衫是天蓝色的！

options.scaffold_zh: 妈妈问的是衬衫的颜色（what colour），试试回答 My shirt is sky blue! 吧！
在卧室衣柜前选衣服，回答衬衫的颜色吧！

turns.npc_en: It looks very neat! It's a little cool this morning — please put on your warm coat too.
turns.npc_zh: 真精神！今天早上有点凉——请把暖和的外套也穿上吧。

options.en: OK, Mom! Look at my coat — it's so warm!
options.zh: 好的妈妈！看我的外套——真暖和呀！

options.scaffold_zh: 听妈妈的话穿上暖外套，回应 OK, Mom! Look at my coat! 最棒！
先把外套穿上（OK, Mom!）再去吃早饭吧！

turns.npc_en: Don't forget your socks and shoes under the chair! Ready for school?
turns.npc_zh: 别忘了椅子下面的袜子和鞋子哦！准备好去学校了吗？

options.en: Yes! My shoes are on. Let's go!
options.zh: 准备好啦！鞋子穿好啦，我们出发吧！

options.scaffold_zh: 早上精神饱满去上学，选 Yes! My shoes are on. Let's go! 吧！
穿好鞋子回应妈妈 Ready for school? 吧！

home_s2_kitchen_cooking_mom.grammar_tag: 厨房现在进行时 (am/is cooking) · Can I help you?
home_s2_kitchen_cooking_mom.grammar_tip: 走进厨房问妈妈正在煮什么用 What are you cooking? 妈妈回答 I'm cooking...；主动帮忙说 Can I help you?
home_s2_kitchen_cooking_mom.book_ref: 湘少版四年级下册 · Unit 4–5 家庭厨房正在进行时
home_s2_kitchen_cooking_mom.speaker: 妈妈 Mom · 明亮厨房
home_s2_kitchen_cooking_mom.title_zh: 在厨房看妈妈正在做什么菜并主动帮忙

turns.npc_en: Mmm, welcome to the kitchen! Look at the pot — can you guess what I am cooking?
turns.npc_zh: 嗯～欢迎来到厨房！看看汤锅——你能猜出我【正在煮】什么吗？（am cooking 进行时）

options.en: Wow, it smells great! Are you cooking tomato and egg soup?
options.zh: 哇，好香呀！您正在煮西红柿鸡蛋汤吗？（Are you cooking...）
时态不对哦（正在煮要用进行时）
options.scaffold_zh: 妈妈问此刻正在煮什么（am cooking），疑问句要用【Are you cooking...?】哦！
闻闻厨房锅里的香味，猜猜妈妈正在煮西红柿鸡蛋汤吧！

turns.npc_en: Yes, I am! And Dad is setting the bowls on the dining table. Would you like to help?
turns.npc_zh: 猜对啦！爸爸正在餐厅摆碗筷呢。你也想来帮个忙吗？

options.en: Yes! I am washing the red tomatoes in the sink now!
options.zh: 好呀！我现在正在水槽里洗红西红柿呢！（am washing）

options.scaffold_zh: 说自己“现在正在洗西红柿”（now），要用【I am washing...】现在进行时！
帮妈妈在水槽里洗西红柿，选 I am washing the red tomatoes... 吧！

turns.npc_en: What a helpful kid! Look in the fridge — can you pass me the fresh milk?
turns.npc_zh: 真是懂事的小帮手！看看冰箱里——能把鲜牛奶递给我吗？

options.en: Sure, Mom! Here is the cold milk from the fridge.
options.zh: 没问题妈妈！这是从冰箱拿出来的冰牛奶。

options.scaffold_zh: 把牛奶递给妈妈时热情回应 Sure, Mom! Here is the cold milk!
在家里帮妈妈拿牛奶，选 Sure, Mom! 吧！

school_s1_classroom_miss_li.grammar_tag: 校园问候 · What's your name? · 课堂祈使句 & 借文具
school_s1_classroom_miss_li.grammar_tip: 在学校认识同学用 Hello, I'm... What's your name? 课堂听老师指令用祈使句 Open your book / Look at the blackboard！
school_s1_classroom_miss_li.book_ref: 湘少版三年级上册 · Unit 1–3 校园问候与课堂初体验
school_s1_classroom_miss_li.speaker: 李老师 Miss Li · 阳光教室
school_s1_classroom_miss_li.title_zh: 在学校和李老师、同桌问好并准备上课

turns.npc_en: Good morning, boys and girls! Welcome to our sunny classroom!
turns.npc_zh: 同学们早上好！欢迎来到我们的阳光教室！

options.en: Good morning, Miss Li! Nice to meet you!
options.zh: 早上好，李老师！很高兴见到您！

options.scaffold_zh: 现在在阳光教室里和李老师上课呢，回应 Good morning, Miss Li! 吧！
先礼貌回应李老师的早安问候（Good morning, Miss Li!）哦！

turns.npc_en: Class begins! Please sit on your chair and take out your English book.
turns.npc_zh: 上课啦！请在椅子上坐好，把你的英语书拿出来放在课桌上。

options.en: OK, Miss Li! Look, my English book is on my desk.
options.zh: 好的李老师！看，我的英语书已经在课桌上啦。

options.scaffold_zh: 课堂上要拿的是英语书（English book），选 my English book is on my desk 吧！
刚刚开始上课呢，快把英语书放到课桌上回应老师吧！

turns.npc_en: Mingming whispers beside you: 'Excuse me, may I borrow your pencil?' How do you reply?
turns.npc_zh: 同桌明明小声问你：“打扰一下，我可以借用你的铅笔吗？”你怎么回答他？

options.scaffold_zh: 把东西递给同学时，地道英语说 Here you are!（给你！）
友善地把铅笔借给同桌，说 Sure! Here you are! 吧！

school_s2_playground_peter.grammar_tag: Whose 归属询问 · 情态动词 Can you...? · 现在进行时 (be + doing)
school_s2_playground_peter.grammar_tip: 问物品是谁的用 Whose... is this? 问运动特长用 Can you...? 看操场上同学正在运动用【现在进行时：He/She is running / jumping】！
school_s2_playground_peter.book_ref: 湘少版四年级上册 & 下册 · 操场运动能力与课间正在发生的事
school_s2_playground_peter.speaker: 彼得 Peter · 课间操场对话
school_s2_playground_peter.title_zh: 在操场和同学认领物品、聊运动正在进行时

turns.npc_en: Hey friend! I found a blue basketball by the bench. Whose basketball is this?
turns.npc_zh: 嘿好朋友！我在休息椅旁发现了一颗篮球。这颗篮球【是谁的】？（Whose）

options.en: Let me see — it has Tim's name! It's Tim's basketball.
options.zh: 我看看——上面有蒂姆的名字！它是蒂姆的篮球。（Tim's 名词所有格）

options.scaffold_zh: 注意疑问词 Whose（谁的），回答要用人名 + 's（Tim's basketball）表示归属哦！
试试用 It's Tim's basketball 回答篮球是谁的吧！

turns.npc_en: Look at the green playground! What are Anne and Dongdong doing over there?
turns.npc_zh: 快看绿茵操场上！安妮和东东在那边【正在做什么】呢？（What are they doing）

options.en: Anne is jumping rope, and Dongdong is running fast!
options.zh: 安妮正在跳绳，东东正在飞快地跑步！（is jumping / is running）

options.scaffold_zh: 描述眼前正在进行的动作，一定要用【be + 动词ing】：Anne is jumping rope!
Peter 问的是正在做的动作（doing），选 Anne is jumping rope... 吧！

turns.npc_en: So cool! Can you play football with me right now?
turns.npc_zh: 太酷啦！你现在【会/能】和我一起踢足球吗？（Can you...?）

options.en: Yes, I can! Let's kick the football into the goal!
options.zh: 当然会！（Yes, I can!）我们一起把球踢进球门吧！
答词不匹配（Can you 要用 I can 回答）
options.scaffold_zh: 语法小窍门：Can you...? 提问时，肯定回答是 Yes, I can! 哦！
在球场上回应 Peter 的邀球，选 Yes, I can! Let's kick the football... 吧！

school_s3_plan_and_canteen.grammar_tag: 一般将来时 (be going to) · 时刻日常习惯 · 礼貌意愿 I'd like...
school_s3_plan_and_canteen.grammar_tip: 和同学讨论今天课程或活动计划用【be going to + 动词原形】；在学校食堂点餐用礼貌表达 I'd like some..., please！（而不是生硬的 I want）
school_s3_plan_and_canteen.book_ref: 湘少版五年级上册 U2 校园点餐 & 五年级下册 U1–2 课堂阅读研究计划
school_s3_plan_and_canteen.speaker: 玲玲 Lingling · 课堂计划与午餐
school_s3_plan_and_canteen.title_zh: 在学校和玲玲讨论今日课程计划与食堂点餐

turns.npc_en: Hi! Look at our class timetable! What are we going to do in English class today?
turns.npc_zh: 嗨！快看我们的课程表！今天英语课我们【打算】做什么呀？（are we going to do）

options.en: We're going to read stories and put on a short play!
options.zh: 我们打算读故事，还要演一出趣味短剧！（are going to + 动词原形）

options.en: We went to the park last year.
options.zh: 我们去年去了公园。（过去时）
options.scaffold_zh: 问句用了 What are we going to do today，回答也要用【We're going to...】将来计划句型哦！
和玲玲讨论英语课打算做什么，选 We're going to read stories... 吧！

turns.npc_en: I love reading stories! By the way, what time do you usually have lunch at school?
turns.npc_zh: 我最爱读故事啦！对了，你平时在学校通常几点吃午饭呀？（usually 一般现在时）

options.en: I usually have lunch at twelve o'clock in the canteen.
options.zh: 我通常十二点整在学校餐厅吃午饭。

options.scaffold_zh: 回答日常习惯时间（what time do you usually...），用一般现在时 I usually have lunch at...！
回答几点吃午饭，用 at twelve o'clock 最准确！

turns.npc_en: Look, we're at the canteen window now! What would you like for lunch today?
turns.npc_zh: 看，我们到取餐窗口啦！今天午饭你【想要】吃点什么？（What would you like）

options.en: I'd like some roast chicken, rice, and orange juice, please!
options.zh: 我想要一份烤鸡肉、米饭和鲜橙汁，谢谢！（I'd like = I would like）

options.scaffold_zh: 在食堂点餐，用礼貌句型 I'd like some..., please! 选择美味食物吧！
回应 What would you like?，选 I'd like some roast chicken... 吧！

school_s4_past_and_compare.grammar_tag: 一般过去时 (Where did you go / went / saw) · 形容词比较级 (-er than)
school_s4_past_and_compare.grammar_tip: 周一返校和同学聊周末去哪儿玩了，疑问用 Where did you go? 回答用过去式 went / saw / took；对比两个事物用【比较级：taller / bigger / faster than】！
school_s4_past_and_compare.book_ref: 湘少版六年级上册 & 下册 · 周末旅行过去时与科学观察比较级
school_s4_past_and_compare.speaker: 安妮 Anne · 周末见闻与科学对比
school_s4_past_and_compare.title_zh: 在学校和安妮聊上周末去了哪里、对比植物生长

turns.npc_en: Good to see you back at school! Where did you go with your parents last Sunday?
turns.npc_zh: 返校见到你真开心！上个星期天你和爸爸妈妈【去了哪里】呀？（Where did you go 过去时）

options.en: We went to the forest park and saw many tall green trees!
options.zh: 我们去了森林公园，还看到了许多高大的绿树！（went / saw 过去式）

options.en: We go to the park tomorrow.
options.zh: 时间词冲突（last Sunday 要用过去式 went）
options.scaffold_zh: 看到 last Sunday（上周日）和 did you go，回答一定要把 go 变成过去式 went、see 变成 saw 哦！

options.en: My pencil is in the box.
options.scaffold_zh: 安妮在问你上周日去了哪里，选 We went to the forest park... 吧！

turns.npc_en: Sounds amazing! Come look at our two bean plants on the science table. Which one is taller?
turns.npc_zh: 听起来棒极了！快来看科学桌上我们种的两盆小豆苗，哪一棵【更高】呢？（taller 比较级）

options.en: Look! Your plant is taller than mine, and its leaves are bigger!
options.zh: 看！你的豆苗比我的更高，而且叶片也更大！（taller than / bigger）

options.en: Your plant is tall than mine.
options.zh: 少了比较级尾巴 -er（应为 taller than）
options.scaffold_zh: 语法关键点：有 than（比……）出现时，形容词要变比较级：tall → taller than，big → bigger！
观察两盆豆苗的高低对比，选 Your plant is taller than mine... 吧！

turns.npc_en: Because we watered it every day! Look outside — Peter and Tim are racing. Who runs faster?
turns.npc_zh: 因为我们每天都给它浇水呀！再看窗外操场——彼得和蒂姆在赛跑，谁跑得【更快】？（faster）

options.en: Peter runs faster than Tim today — let's cheer for both of them!
options.zh: 今天彼得跑得比蒂姆更快——我们去为他们俩加油吧！（faster than）
时态与比较级都不对哦
options.scaffold_zh: 回答 Who runs faster?（谁跑得更快），用比较级 runs faster than Tim 最地道！
选 Peter runs faster than Tim today... 一起为同学喝彩吧！

school_s2_music_art_lin.grammar_tag: 情态动词 Can you play...? · 艺术课现在进行时 (is playing / drawing)
school_s2_music_art_lin.grammar_tip: 西方乐器前要加 the（play the piano / violin）；看同学正在演奏或画画用【现在进行时：She is playing / drawing...】！
school_s2_music_art_lin.book_ref: 湘少版四年级下册 · 音乐美术社团与正在进行的才艺展示
school_s2_music_art_lin.speaker: 林老师 Miss Lin · 音乐与艺术社团
school_s2_music_art_lin.title_zh: 在音乐与美术室聊乐器特长与正在创作的作品

turns.npc_en: Welcome to our sunny art and music club! Listen — Anne is on the stage. What is she doing?
turns.npc_zh: 欢迎来到阳光艺术音乐社团！听——安妮在舞台上呢，她【正在做什么】？

options.en: She is playing the violin! The music sounds so sweet!
options.zh: 她正在拉小提琴！（is playing the violin）琴声真好听！
缺少进行时 is playing 和冠词 the
options.scaffold_zh: 注意两个课本细节：①正在做用 is playing；②乐器前加 the → She is playing the violin!
听舞台上的琴声，选 She is playing the violin! 吧！

turns.npc_en: Can you play the piano or tap the red drum with us?
turns.npc_zh: 你会弹钢琴，或者和我们一起敲节奏大鼓吗？（Can you...?）

options.en: Yes, I can! I can tap a happy rhythm on the drum!
options.zh: 我会！（Yes, I can!）我能在大鼓上敲出欢快的节奏！

options.scaffold_zh: Can you...? 提问时，用 Yes, I can! I can... 回答最地道！
在音乐教室里一起合奏，选 Yes, I can! I can tap... 吧！

turns.npc_en: Bravo! And look at Lingling by the easel — what is she painting with her brush?
turns.npc_zh: 太棒了！再看画架旁的玲玲——她【正在画】什么呢？

options.en: She is painting blue sky, green trees, and our sunny school!
options.zh: 她正在画蓝天、绿树和我们的阳光学校！（is painting）

options.scaffold_zh: 问 what is she painting，回答要用现在进行时 She is painting...!
和林老师一起欣赏玲玲正在画的校园风景吧！

school_s3_football_mr_wang.grammar_tag: 体育比赛将来计划 (be going to) · 团队规则 must / mustn't
school_s3_football_mr_wang.grammar_tip: 赛前布置战术计划用【We are going to...】；球场安全与文明守则用情态动词 must（必须）/ mustn't（禁止）+ 动词原形！
school_s3_football_mr_wang.book_ref: 湘少版五年级下册 · 校园体育活动计划与规则意识
school_s3_football_mr_wang.speaker: 王老师 Mr Wang · 绿茵足球场
school_s3_football_mr_wang.title_zh: 在足球场听王老师布置比赛计划与运动守则

turns.npc_en: Team, gather by the bench! We are going to have a friendly football match this afternoon!
turns.npc_zh: 队员们到替补席集合！今天下午我们【即将举行】一场足球友谊赛！（are going to have）

options.en: Hooray! What are we going to do first, Mr Wang?
options.zh: 太棒啦！王老师，那我们第一步打算做什么呢？（are we going to do）
过去式 had 不能搭配 tomorrow 哦
options.scaffold_zh: 询问接下来的训练安排，用将来时 What are we going to do first?
在球场上回应王老师，问问第一步准备做什么训练吧！

turns.npc_en: First, we're going to warm up and pass the ball around the orange cones!
turns.npc_zh: 首先，我们要热身，并绕着橙色标志桶练习传球！

options.en: Got it! Tim and I will pass the football carefully!
options.zh: 明白！我和蒂姆会认真配合传球的！（will pass 将来时）

options.scaffold_zh: 表达接下来会努力做好，用将来时 Tim and I will pass the football!
选 Got it! Tim and I will pass the football carefully! 吧！

turns.npc_en: Remember our playground rule: what must we do during the game?
turns.npc_zh: 记住我们的球场文明守则：比赛时我们【必须】做到什么？（must + 动词原形）

options.en: We must play safely and help our teammates! We mustn't push!
options.zh: 我们必须安全运动、互助队友，绝不能推搡！（must / mustn't）
情态动词 must 后面要用动词原形 play / push 哦
options.scaffold_zh: 记住口诀：must / mustn't 后面跟动词原形 → We must play safely!
说出球场文明守则 We must play safely and help our teammates! 吧！
